name: The horde
goal: Two Goblin Swarms and Skeleton Archers: a crowd of small bodies. You have 200 gold.
hint: Splash hits many bodies at once. Fire Mage beats crowds.
why: Fire Mage’s splash hits a whole crowd with every shot.

name: Two giants
goal: Two Brutes: huge health, huge hits. You have 300 gold.
hint: A Brute hits one body at a time. Many cheap bodies swamp it: Goblin Swarms, up front.
why: A Brute kills one goblin a hit while the whole swarm hits back.

name: Out of reach
goal: Two Fire Mages behind a Brute. Crowds melt in their splash. You have 300 gold.
hint: Few targets, all of them single bodies: Snipers outrange Fire Mages and land one big hit each shot.
why: Snipers shoot from beyond the Fire Mages’ reach, and their splash finds no crowd.

name: Hold the line
goal: Two Spider nests: twelve fast biters that run straight for your back line. You have 300 gold.
hint: Fire Mages burn spiders, but not if the spiders reach them first. Put an Ent in front, with the Fire Mages right behind it.
why: The spiders stopped to chew on the Ent, and the Fire Mages burned them while they were busy. Tough units go in front, damage behind.

name: The long way round
goal: A Brute guards two Fire Mages in their corner, and there are no Snipers this time. You have 300 gold.
hint: Squads march straight down their own side of the board. Goblins on the far side run past the Brute and reach the Fire Mages first.
why: Down the far side the goblins slipped past the Brute and caught the Fire Mages. Where you place a squad decides who it meets first.

name: Through the wall
goal: A Brute and an Ent stand in front of a Fire Mage, with a Leaf Wizard out on the wing. You have 400 gold.
hint: Snipers alone can't break the Brute and the Ent. The Earth Wizard throws huge stones that go through their first target: two Snipers and an Earth Wizard, facing them.
why: The Earth Wizard's stones broke the wall and hit what stood behind it, while the Snipers picked off the casters from out of reach.
